name: Pitch Gripper

sectionX.label: Section length X (m)
sectionX.desc: Length of each section's pickup box along the rail. Size it to the products one section should take: a section picks every product whose centre is inside its box. The orange dots on the tool drag it, and they ride the arm.

sectionY.label: Section height Y (m)
sectionY.desc: Height of each pickup box, centred on the box centre.

sectionZ.label: Section depth Z (m)
sectionZ.desc: Depth of each pickup box across the rail, and the length of the jaws.

gripDepth.label: Box centre below flange (m)
gripDepth.desc: How far below the tool flange the centre of each pickup box sits. The jaws are as long as it takes to reach the box.

pitchMin.label: Closed pitch (m)
pitchMin.desc: Centre-to-centre distance between the two boxes with the axis closed, which is where the tool rests. Keep it at least the section length, or the boxes overlap and a product between them is taken by both.

pitchMax.label: Open pitch (m)
pitchMax.desc: Centre-to-centre distance at the end of the axis travel. A setpoint beyond it is held at it.

axisSpeed.label: Axis speed (m/s)
axisSpeed.desc: How fast the pitch changes. The two sections each travel half of it.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this tool to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on. Without a program the tool rests closed with both sections open.

pitchTag.label: Pitch tag (m, centre to centre)
pitchTag.desc: The pitch the program commands, between the closed and the open pitch. The axis moves there at the axis speed, so wait for Pitch reached before the sections set the load down.

gripATag.label: Section A grip tag (true closes)
gripATag.desc: Close section A on the products in its box. It is read continuously, so hold it true for the whole carry and drop it only once the products are where they belong. Section A is the one at the lower X.

gripBTag.label: Section B grip tag (true closes)
gripBTag.desc: Close section B, separately from section A. Section B is the one at the higher X.

pitchOkTag.label: Pitch reached tag
pitchOkTag.desc: True while the axis is at the commanded pitch.

heldATag.label: Section A holding tag
heldATag.desc: True while section A holds at least one product. A close that finds nothing in the box leaves it false.

heldBTag.label: Section B holding tag
heldBTag.desc: True while section B holds at least one product.
